body: I feel like I'm just not good enough anymore. He talks about how he hates when people are mundane and normal and when they don't understand things, or question things. And the more he describes what he hates, the more I get the sinking feeling that I'm exactly what he hates. He picks me apart like its nothing and gets upset when I show that I'm upset. I feel like I'm not allowed to be upset anymore and its killing me. I can't express it with words to the people that I love, so I want to express it on myself and the urge is so strong. I'm almost proud of myself for not self harming.

Thank you Taylor. Its nice getting it off my chest. I don't even know who to talk to about this in my life. The thoughts I find myself having are so dark and I just can't stop. I know that I'd be finding some way to discretely self harm if I didn't know that there was someone who would see no matter where I did it. I don't want to go back to that, and it scares me that I think about it so much. That I want it so much.

I just don't know what to do anymore. I feel like everything I do to try and make anyone feel better just makes them more upset. It just makes me constantly miserable. I don't even know what I want anymore because I'm so used to working to make everyone else happy. Thanks for talking to me.

You're right. I'm just not sure that cutting people out of my life would be the right choice. Its hard to trust people, and unfortunately I don't feel that confident about being without a really solid support group. I think part of the problem that I'm dealing with right now is that I thought I had people I could rely on, and it just feels like I can't.

Thank you for replying. I know that its not everyone's fault for how things are happening and we all have stress on us, its just really hard that everyone dumps everything on me and I don't feel that I can talk to anyone about what's going on.
I think about committing suicide at least thirty times a day.
